traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 47 Araliaceae and 311 Umbelliferae, the bulk of APG's Apiales: the calyx adnate to an inferior ovary, the petals and stamens on top of it. Pittosporaceae, also in the order, have a superior ovary.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): families described with spiral or two-ranked leaves; opposite leaves rare (a few Araliaceae). Fills Myodocarpaceae and Torricelliaceae.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral in most families; Griseliniaceae noted as often two-ranked (override).

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): Apiaceae and many Araliaceae compound, Myodocarpaceae pinnately compound; Pittosporaceae, Griseliniaceae, Pennantiaceae, Torricelliaceae simple. 'usually compound' is our weighting by species (Apiaceae ~3,800).

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): Apiaceae and Myodocarpaceae pinnate; Aralioideae pinnate to palmate. Weighting ours (Apiaceae).

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Apiales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence terminal, branched. DELTA Pittosporaceae: at branch tips or in axils.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers small, regular; zygomorphy only in the radiant outer flowers of some Apiaceae umbels.

traits.zygomorphy.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): zygomorphic flowers are the enlarged outer-petalled marginal flowers of some Apiaceae umbels, neither bilabiate nor papilionaceous.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Apiales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): petals apparently free, valvate, spreading in Apiaceae/Araliaceae (both state rotate).

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Apiales page (read 2026-10-16): dioecy may be ancestral but perfect flowers and monoecy (andromonoecy) now predominate; Araliaceae flowers often perfect. Weighting ours.
